title: Decision Evidence Ledger
question: Why was this decision made, and can its evidence and result be reconstructed?
questionStatus: implementation copy derived from canonical job
thesis: A decision is accountable only when its actor, authority, time, evidence, alternatives, acknowledgement, result, and correction history remain linked without silently replacing earlier records.
thesisStatus: implementation copy derived from canonical job and B-web
requiredEvidenceRule: Every fixture marked required must remain linked; record count alone never establishes completeness.
correctionRule: append a separately identified correction linked to the original record; preserve the original value and never silently overwrite
exportRule: synthetic client-local JSON only; no submission or server retention
limitations: a complete record does not prove a correct or lawful decision
